description: Reviewed functions that cannot be matched with the available toolchain, by address only. A function is listed when a documented search ruled it out (see notes); it is not a promise that no other toolchain could match it. tools/hstattempts.py and tools/hstqueue.py read this file: queues never offer a blocked function and the progress figures count it separately. Remove an entry when a new compiler, flag or source form reaches it.
